entities.summary:
Susan Hale was an American author, traveler and artist. She was a prolific writer as well as a famous watercolor painter, art which she studied under English, French and German masters. Hale traveled extensively and visited the art galleries of the world, leading to many writings, paintings and sketches of the places she visited. She was associated with her brother, the Rev.

Edward Everett Hale, in the publication of The Family Flight series, which included the several countries she had visited. She also exhibited her paintings of the White Mountains in New Hampshire, of North Carolina scenery and of foreign scenes, in New York City and Boston. Susan Hale was a authors & novelists from Boston (1833-12-05, Boston–1910-09-17). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Susan Hale's writings and art documented her extensive travels across North America, contributing to a greater understanding of regional scenery and culture. Her work also supported her brother Edward Everett Hale's publication of The Family Flight series.
